name: io.github.chrisgleissner/c64bridge
title: C64 Bridge
description: MCP server for Commodore 64 Ultimate hardware and VICE emulator control.

environmentVariables.name: C64BRIDGE_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the C64 Bridge configuration file.

environmentVariables.name: C64_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Active backend (c64u/U64 hardware, u2/U2-family cartridge, or vice emulator).

environmentVariables.name: C64U_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Ultimate 64 host name or IP address.

environmentVariables.name: C64U_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Ultimate 64 network password sent as X-Password.

environmentVariables.name: U2_HOST
environmentVariables.description: U2/U2+/U2+L host name or IP address when C64_MODE=u2.

environmentVariables.name: U2_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: U2-family network password sent as X-Password.

environmentVariables.name: VICE_VISIBLE
environmentVariables.description: Launch VICE with a visible window when possible.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub token for optional RAG discovery against GitHub.
